steps: 分别模拟提交前 revision 冲突且无未决恢复记录、交换后 displaced 校验冲突；回读 current 分别等于 candidate 与不同值。
expected: 只有无未决恢复记录、身份/revision 核对通过的普通提交前冲突，回读等于提交内容才可按主进程权威结果视已存；不同值进入普通手工冲突。提交后恢复冲突即使 current 等于 candidate 仍保留 current/displaced/draft、暂停自动保存，不强制覆盖或误报已保存。

U.coverage: Production FileBuffer dirty/conflict/recovery gate, actual EditorState edits and 3500ms fake-clock autosave boundary.

I.chain: Actual FileBuffer -> FileService -> NativeFileBroker -> macOS filesystem and durable transaction/checkpoint storage. Precommit uses packaged r6 helper; exchange fault uses unchanged broker.mm compiled with existing test suspension flag.

actual.ordinaryEqual: Original save() returns false/conflict and retains local/base. A subsequent explicit refresh re-reads exact raw+BOM and authoritative revision, clears ordinary conflict and becomes clean. No synthetic saved receipt or source write; original conflict result is not hidden.
actual.ordinaryDifferent: Save and refresh retain local/base plus actual disk alternative; dirty ordinary conflict remains; 3500ms does not save or overwrite source.
actual.displacedEqual: Actual atomic exchange then old open fd modification triggers native Displaced conflict while current bytes equal candidate. Current, displaced, materialized and independent draft plus journal retain their exact bytes/inodes/timestamps; buffer remains dirty/recoveryBlocked even after refresh, timers and explicit save/keepLocal attempts.
actual.displacedDifferent: After the same actual displaced conflict receipt, an independent atomic rename replaces current path before buffer readback. Current becomes the third writer; displaced and independent draft remain intact. No second source save, automatic rollback or false saved result.
actual.policyInterpretation: Original wording 只有…才可 is an authorization condition, not a requirement to fabricate immediate success. The conservative explicit-refresh convergence is recorded openly; root independently confirmed this interpretation in the task conversation.
